WITH overall_avg AS (
  SELECT AVG(HGB) as overall_average FROM Laboratory WHERE HGB IS NOT NULL
),
patient_avgs AS (
  SELECT ID, AVG(HGB) as patient_avg 
  FROM Laboratory 
  WHERE HGB IS NOT NULL 
  GROUP BY ID
),
above_average_patients AS (
  SELECT pa.ID, pa.patient_avg
  FROM patient_avgs pa
  CROSS JOIN overall_avg oa
  WHERE pa.patient_avg > oa.overall_average
),
above_avg_average AS (
  SELECT AVG(patient_avg) as avg_of_above_average FROM above_average_patients
)
SELECT 
  aap.ID,
  aap.patient_avg,
  aap.patient_avg - oa.overall_average as above_overall_avg,
  aap.patient_avg - aaa.avg_of_above_average as diff_from_above_avg_mean
FROM above_average_patients aap
CROSS JOIN overall_avg oa
CROSS JOIN above_avg_average aaa
ORDER BY diff_from_above_avg_mean DESC
LIMIT 10
